title: metadata-core: an exclusive protocol comparator ('>18', '<18') on an 18 runtime prescribes migrate meta --from 18, which cannot apply
body:
Filing gate: ① a defect measured by the #26480 card thread on its branch's built `metadata-core` dist (not over live HTTP), reported as an out-of-scope finding in os-dev-report `6436225748` on #26480. Filed by the `domain:server` seat 1. ⛔ Not a claim.
Business reason: an operator installing a package whose `engines.protocol` uses an exclusive comparator is told to run a migration that cannot apply. On an 18 runtime, `'>18'` (19 and up: the package is ahead) and `'<18'` (17 and below: the package is behind) are both refused with `migrateCommand: 'objectstack migrate meta --from 18'`.
Reader: `packages/metadata-core/src/protocol-handshake.ts` (`declaredFloorMajor`, and the prescription in `checkProtocolCompat`), reached by `POST /api/v1/packages` and the local marketplace install.

## What the code does (`origin/main`, and PR #26530's branch)

- `declaredFloorMajor` peels every leading `^ ~ < > =` off each alternative and takes the bare major (`protocol-handshake.ts` about :372). `'>18'` and `'<18'` both give 18.
- The refusal then prescribes `migrate meta --from 18`, a migration from the runtime's own major, which is a no-op or wrong in both cases.
- PR #26530 (#26480) makes a floor ABOVE the runtime's major name the runtime upgrade instead of `migrateCommand`. Its ruling covered that case only. An exclusive comparator whose bound equals the runtime's major keeps the `--from 18` answer, because the peeled floor is not above the runtime's.

## Wanted (for triage to grade)

- The target major reads the comparator's direction: `'>N'` (bare) targets N+1 and up, so on an N runtime it is the ahead case (#26480's upgrade remedy); `'<N'` targets N-1 and below, so the prescription is `--from N-1` (or the lowest major the range admits).
- Red first: a `checkProtocolCompat` case for each of `'>18'`, `'<18'`, `'>=19'` and `'<=17'` on an 18 runtime, checking `targetMajor`, `migrateCommand` and the message.
- Note for the spec seat, not this card's surface: the `OS_PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE` row comment in `packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts` lists `migrateCommand` among `error.details` members; after #26530 it is absent in the ahead case. Comment only.
- Land after PR #26530, on top of its ahead/behind split.

Dedupe: searched `OS_PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE`, `declaredFloorMajor`, `exclusive comparator`, `migrate meta --from`. Found only #26480 (the floor-above case, PR #26530) and #25235 (its parent sweep).
